select cc.contract_id, cc.contract_number, cc.manufacturer_id, cc.business_type, cc.lease_item_amount CONTRACT_AMOUNT, --合同金额 (select min(cwo.write_off_date) from csh_write_off cwo where cwo.contract_id = cc.contract_id and cwo.cf_item = '0' ) DELIVERY_TIME, --投放日期 cc.lease_term, --租赁期限 round( (select sum(nvl(ccc.due_amount,0) - nvl(ccc.received_amount, 0)) from con_contract_cashflow ccc where ccc.contract_id = cc.contract_id and ccc.cf_type = 1), 2) REMAINING_RENT, --剩余租金 round( (select sum(nvl(ccc.principal,0) - nvl(ccc.received_principal, 0)) from con_contract_cashflow ccc where ccc.contract_id = cc.contract_id and ccc.cf_type = 1), 2) REMAINING_PRINCIPAL, --剩余本金 nvl(round((select sum(nvl(csh.transaction_amount, 0)) - sum(nvl(csh.write_off_amount, 0)) from csh_transaction csh where csh.contract_id = cc.contract_id and csh.business_type = 'DEPOSIT'), 2), 0) REMAINING_MARGIN, --剩余保证金 round((select sum(nvl(ccc.due_amount, 0) - nvl(ccc.received_amount, 0)) from con_contract_cashflow ccc where ccc.cf_type = 1 and ccc.due_date < sysdate and ccc.write_off_flag != 'FULL' and ccc.contract_id = cc.contract_id), 2) OVERDUE_RENT, --逾期租金 round((sysdate - (select min(ccc.due_date) from con_contract_cashflow ccc where ccc.contract_id = cc.contract_id and ccc.cf_type = 1 and ccc.write_off_flag != 'FULL' and ccc.due_date < sysdate))) OVERDUE_DAYS, --逾期天数 round(nvl((select sum(nvl(ccc.due_amount, 0) - nvl(ccc.received_amount, 0)) from con_contract_cashflow ccc where ccc.contract_id = cc.contract_id and ccc.cf_item = '9'), 0), 2) PENALTY_INTEREST, --罚息 (round( (select sum(nvl(ccc.principal,0) - nvl(ccc.received_principal, 0)) from con_contract_cashflow ccc where ccc.contract_id = cc.contract_id and ccc.cf_type = 1), 2) - nvl(round((select sum(nvl(csh.transaction_amount, 0)) - sum(nvl(csh.write_off_amount, 0)) from csh_transaction csh where csh.contract_id = cc.contract_id and csh.business_type = 'DEPOSIT'), 2), 0)) REMAINING_EXPOSURE --剩余敞口 from con_contract cc
cc.contract_status in ('INCEPT', 'PENDING')

SELECT HAC.INITIAL_LEVEL, HAC.REVIEW_LEVEL, HAC.MANUFACTURER_ID, HAC.CLASS_HEAD_ID, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'ASSET_CLASS' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = HAC.INITIAL_LEVEL) INITIAL_LEVEL_N, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'ASSET_CLASS' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = HAC.REVIEW_LEVEL) REVIEW_LEVEL_N, (SELECT HBM.BP_NAME FROM HLS_BP_MASTER HBM WHERE HBM.BP_ID = HAC.MANUFACTURER_ID) MANUFACTURER_ID_N, ROUND(SUM(HAC.CONTRACT_AMOUNT), 2) LEASE_ITEM_AMOUNT, --投放金额 ROUND(SUM(HAC.REMAINING_RENT), 2) RESIDUAL_RENT, --剩余租金 ROUND(SUM(HAC.Remaining_Principal), 2) RESIDUAL_PRINCIPAL, --剩余本金 ROUND(SUM(HAC.Overdue_Rent), 2) OVERDUE_RENT, --逾期租金 ROUND(max(HAC.Overdue_Days), 2) OVERDUE_DAYS, --最大逾期天数 ROUND(SUM(HAC.PENALTY_INTEREST), 2) LATE_CHARGE, --逾期罚息 ROUND(SUM(HAC.REMAINING_EXPOSURE), 2) EXPOSURE, --剩余敞口 ROUND(SUM(HAC.REMAINING_MARGIN), 2) RESIDUAL_DEPOSIT --剩余保证金 FROM HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HAC WHERE HAC.CLASS_HEAD_ID = #{classHeadId} group by HAC.INITIAL_LEVEL, HAC.REVIEW_LEVEL, HAC.MANUFACTURER_ID,HAC.CLASS_HEAD_ID

SELECT HAC.INITIAL_LEVEL, HAC.REVIEW_LEVEL, HAC.MANUFACTURER_ID, HAC.CLASS_HEAD_ID, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'ASSET_CLASS' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = HAC.INITIAL_LEVEL) INITIAL_LEVEL_N, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'ASSET_CLASS' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = HAC.REVIEW_LEVEL) REVIEW_LEVEL_N, (SELECT HBM.BP_NAME FROM HLS_BP_MASTER HBM WHERE HBM.BP_ID = HAC.MANUFACTURER_ID) MANUFACTURER_ID_N, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'ASSET_CLASS' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = HAC.APPROVE_REVIEW_LEVEL) APPROVE_REVIEW_LEVEL_N, HAC.APPROVE_REVIEW_LEVEL, ROUND(SUM(HAC.CONTRACT_AMOUNT), 2) LEASE_ITEM_AMOUNT, --投放金额 ROUND(SUM(HAC.REMAINING_RENT), 2) RESIDUAL_RENT, --剩余租金 ROUND(SUM(HAC.Remaining_Principal), 2) RESIDUAL_PRINCIPAL, --剩余本金 ROUND(SUM(HAC.Overdue_Rent), 2) OVERDUE_RENT, --逾期租金 ROUND(max(HAC.Overdue_Days), 2) OVERDUE_DAYS, --最大逾期天数 ROUND(SUM(HAC.PENALTY_INTEREST), 2) LATE_CHARGE, --逾期罚息 ROUND(SUM(HAC.REMAINING_EXPOSURE), 2) EXPOSURE, --剩余敞口 ROUND(SUM(HAC.REMAINING_MARGIN), 2) RESIDUAL_DEPOSIT --剩余保证金 FROM HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HAC WHERE HAC.CLASS_HEAD_ID = #{classHeadId} group by HAC.INITIAL_LEVEL, HAC.REVIEW_LEVEL, HAC.MANUFACTURER_ID,HAC.CLASS_HEAD_ID,HAC.APPROVE_REVIEW_LEVEL

SELECT HAC.CLASS_LINE_ID, HAC.CLASS_HEAD_ID, HAC.CONTRACT_ID, HAC.CONTRACT_NUMBER, HAC.BUSINESS_TYPE, HAC.INITIAL_LEVEL, HAC.REVIEW_LEVEL, HAC.CONTRACT_AMOUNT, HAC.DELIVERY_TIME, HAC.LEASE_TERM, HAC.REMAINING_RENT, HAC.REMAINING_PRINCIPAL, HAC.REMAINING_MARGIN, HAC.OVERDUE_RENT, HAC.OVERDUE_DAYS, HAC.PENALTY_INTEREST, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'ASSET_CLASS' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = HAC.INITIAL_LEVEL) INITIAL_LEVEL_N, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'ASSET_CLASS' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = HAC.REVIEW_LEVEL) REVIEW_LEVEL_N, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'ASSET_CLASS' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = HAC.APPROVE_REVIEW_LEVEL) APPROVE_REVIEW_LEVEL_N, HAC.APPROVE_REVIEW_LEVEL, TO_CHAR(HAC.DELIVERY_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') DELIVERY_TIME_N, (select hbt.DESCRIPTION from HLS_BUSINESS_TYPE hbt where hbt.BUSINESS_TYPE = HAC.BUSINESS_TYPE and hbt.document_category = 'CONTRACT') as BUSINESS_TYPE_N, hac.manufacturer_id, (SELECT HBM.BP_NAME FROM HLS_BP_MASTER HBM WHERE HBM.BP_ID = HAC.MANUFACTURER_ID) MANUFACTURER_ID_N, hac.remaining_exposure FROM HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HAC WHERE HAC.CLASS_HEAD_ID = #{classHeadId} AND HAC.INITIAL_LEVEL = #{initialLevel} AND HAC.REVIEW_LEVEL = #{reviewLevel} AND HAC.manufacturer_id = #{manufacturerId}

SELECT HAC.CLASS_LINE_ID, HAC.CLASS_HEAD_ID, HAC.CONTRACT_ID, HAC.CONTRACT_NUMBER, HAC.BUSINESS_TYPE, HAC.INITIAL_LEVEL, HAC.REVIEW_LEVEL, HAC.CONTRACT_AMOUNT, HAC.DELIVERY_TIME, HAC.LEASE_TERM, HAC.REMAINING_RENT, HAC.REMAINING_PRINCIPAL, HAC.REMAINING_MARGIN, HAC.OVERDUE_RENT, HAC.OVERDUE_DAYS, HAC.PENALTY_INTEREST, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'ASSET_CLASS' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = HAC.INITIAL_LEVEL) INITIAL_LEVEL_N, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'ASSET_CLASS' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = HAC.REVIEW_LEVEL) REVIEW_LEVEL_N, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'ASSET_CLASS' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = HAC.APPROVE_REVIEW_LEVEL) APPROVE_REVIEW_LEVEL_N, HAC.APPROVE_REVIEW_LEVEL, TO_CHAR(HAC.DELIVERY_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') DELIVERY_TIME_N, (select hbt.DESCRIPTION from HLS_BUSINESS_TYPE hbt where hbt.BUSINESS_TYPE = HAC.BUSINESS_TYPE and hbt.document_category = 'CONTRACT') as BUSINESS_TYPE_N, hac.manufacturer_id, (SELECT HBM.BP_NAME FROM HLS_BP_MASTER HBM WHERE HBM.BP_ID = HAC.MANUFACTURER_ID) MANUFACTURER_ID_N, hac.remaining_exposure FROM HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE HAC WHERE HAC.CLASS_HEAD_ID = #{classHeadId} AND HAC.INITIAL_LEVEL = #{initialLevel} AND HAC.manufacturer_id = #{manufacturerId} AND HAC.APPROVE_REVIEW_LEVEL = #{approveReviewLevel}
select hacl.* from HLS_ASSET_CLASS_LINE hacl where hacl.contract_number=#{contractNumber} and hacl.class_head_id=#{classHeadId}

select head.batch_num, head.class_year, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'QUARTER' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = head.class_season) class_season_n, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'HLS_ASSET_CLASS_HEAD_TYPE' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = head.document_type) DOCUMENT_TYPE_N, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'ASSET_CLASS' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = line.INITIAL_LEVEL) INITIAL_LEVEL_N, (SELECT scv.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE scb.CODE = 'ASSET_CLASS' AND scb.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and scv.value = line.REVIEW_LEVEL) REVIEW_LEVEL_N, to_char(head.approve_time,'YYYY-MM-DD') approve_time_n from hls_asset_class_head head, hls_asset_class_line line where head.class_head_id = line.class_head_id and head.approve_status = 'APPROVED' and line.contract_id = #{contractId}
